description: A route typed as a pilot writes one, read back as item 15 of FAA Form 7233-4 has it (AIM Appendix 4), for the route's one field: split on spaces and commas, DCT (direct) taken out; a cruising speed and level group or a level alone before the first point the cruise's ("N0110A065": 110 kt true, 6,500 ft; "A" and hundreds of feet in three figures, "F" a flight level, 14 CFR 1.1 and 91.121(a)(2); "VFR" a VFR level, no figure; metric speeds and levels give no figure); a point with a group after its stroke ("LEXOR/N0467F380") the point, its level a change from there. The rest are the route's points, airways and procedures in order, upper case, as typed: which is which is the caller's.

text.description: The route as typed or pasted: "KPWK DCT OBK V100 KLAS".

cruise_ft.description: The cruise's altitude, feet MSL; null where none was given or it is VFR's.

tas_kt.description: The cruise's true airspeed, knots, where given in knots.
